text: StockX is a privately held marketplace: per a company-issued 2019 press release, it closed a $110 million Series C funding round from DST Global, General Atlantic and GGV Capital (with existing investors GV and Battery Ventures participating), valuing StockX at over $1 billion. No state or state-fund investor is named among its backers.

source.name: StockX (PR Newswire): Detroit-based StockX Closes $110M Series C Led by DST Global, General Atlantic and GGV Capital
source.quote: StockX, the world's first 'stock market of things', has closed on a $110 million Series C funding round from investment firms DST Global, General Atlantic, and GGV Capital.
source.name: Bitget Wiki article on StockX ownership
